eyebrow: The T-SQL Development Course · Chapter Nine
subtitle: Lesson 101 · Transactions, Locking, and Isolation Levels

eyebrow: Pessimistic -- assume a conflict, block it
code:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ UNCOMMITTED;  -- pessimistic
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL READ COMMITTED;     -- pessimistic
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL REPEATABLE READ;    -- pessimistic
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SERIALIZABLE;        -- most so
caption: All four rely on locks making some other session physically wait.

eyebrow: Optimistic -- assume no conflict, check later
code:
SET TRANSACTION ISOLATION LEVEL SNAPSHOT;  -- optimistic

ALTER DATABASE AdventureWorks2012
  SET READ_COMMITTED_SNAPSHOT ON;          -- optimistic
caption: Never blocks -- just detects a real write-write conflict afterward.

eyebrow: The same idea, at the application level
caption: No isolation setting needed -- the app itself checks for a conflict.

steps.label: PESSIMISTIC
steps.sub: block up front -- costly when conflicts are rare

steps.label: OPTIMISTIC
steps.sub: proceed freely -- costly in retries if conflicts are frequent
